**Is your feature request related to a problem?**
A clear description of what you want and why.

**Describe the solution you'd like**
What should it do? How should it behave?

**Alternatives you've considered**
Other ways to achieve the same thing.

**Scope check** (MVP ya future?)
- [ ] Core feature (data / backtest / agent / paper / live / dashboard)
- [ ] Nice-to-have
- [ ] Big phase (e.g. F&O, new broker, mobile app)

**⚠️ If this touches live trading / risk / money — explain the safety design.**
